chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying regarding a man who died and left wealth, and for him was a mother who was a slave. He said: 'His mother should be bought and emancipated, then the remainder of the wealth should be handed over to her.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to a slave mother in the inheritance of her master who dies?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* details the specific mechanism of *Umm al-Walad* emancipation within Shia inheritance jurisprudence, where the slave mother is purchased from the deceased's estate to secure her freedom. This ruling ensures her transition to an independent status, with any surplus funds from the purchase price or remaining estate distributed according to standard inheritance laws, reflecting the high status of mothers in Islamic law.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding a man who died and left wealth, and for him was a mother who was a slave. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘His mother should be bought and emancipated (with the son’s legacy) then the remainder of the wealth should be handed over to her’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Najran from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following: “

About the case of a man who dies leaving behind a certain amount of assets and a mother who is owned by someone, I once heard abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘His mother is bought, then the rest of the legacy is given to her.”’
